Corollary
[Hopf--Rinow and Myers compactness criterion]

Source: petersen:page-0267 ↗ lem:pet-ch6-bonnet-synge-diameter ↗ def:pet-ch6-sec-bounds

1. ch6:6.3.2

If $(M,g)$ is complete and satisfies $\sec \ge k>0$, then $M$ is compact and $\operatorname {diam}(M,g)\le \pi /\sqrt k=\operatorname {diam}S^n_k$; in particular $\pi _1(M)$ is finite.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch6-bonnet-synge-diameter \sketch By section 3, no minimizing geodesic exceeds $\pi /\sqrt{k}$. Hopf–Rinow gives the diameter bound and compactness; the universal cover is compact, so its deck group is finite.

□
